programme.title: A Country Music Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

programme.title: Christmas at the Amish Bakery (2023)
programme.desc: After leaving her Amish community in her youth, a New York book editor finds herself in desperate need of a new cookbook to save her job. With Christmas on the horizon Sarah heads back to her family farm to reconnect. But with the presence of a handsome local�an outsider, but one that is friendly with the Amish community�he and Sarah sense chemistry and work together to save her family�s Amish bakery (developing an Amish Christmas Cookbook in the process).

programme.title: A Cape Cod Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Margot, a children’s book author, travels to the family beach house on Cape Cod for one last Christmas with her siblings. With her parents gone, her siblings want to sell. Margot commissions her old friend and local artist, Christian, to paint a picture of the house as a keepsake. But Christian is a painter of much greater renown than Margot realizes, and they hatch a plan to keep the house she loves.

programme.title: A Husband for Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Brooke and Roger, two graphic designers in a soon-to-be-merged company, help one another by agreeing to a loveless marriage of convenience, suggested by their new boss. In the process, Brooke gets to upstage the sister who just announced her engagement to Brooke's ex-boyfriend during the holidays. But, with their “marriage” in question, will Brooke and Roger find a spark they didn’t know existed?

programme.title: A Country Music Christmas (2024)
programme.desc: Life changes overnight for songwriting duo Brooke Remington and Chance Owens when NYC producer Rob Benson wants the demo Brooke submitted. But Rob wants Brooke solo. While dazzling her with dreams of stardom, Chance—secretly in love with Brooke—spirals. When Brooke discovers he once hid another big offer from her, she’s furious. Tensions rise until Chance fires her—only for Brooke to realize her heart’s with him, not the spotlight.

programme.title: Christmas Together (2023)
programme.desc: After Ava’s workaholic boyfriend cancels their vacation over the holidays, she leave New York City for California for some time to think. She meets Mia online through a home rental site (not knowing she is only 12 years old), who convinces her widowed Dad Mason to rent out the guest home during the holidays. After arriving in California, Ava realizes the situation and offers to pack up and leave, but both they convince her to stay and enjoy the holidays together.

programme.title: The Christmas Listing (2026)
programme.desc: Julia Rogers, an uptight, hardworking realty owner who’s lost her Christmas spirit, must spend five days at a festive Christmas Inn with her business rival, Chad Everest, to secure the coveted Erickson Farmstead listing. As their competition heats up, unexpected sparks fly, and Julia and Chad discover they share more in common than rivalry, finding that friendship—and maybe even love—can bloom amid holiday cheer.

programme.title: A Christmas Vintage (2023)
programme.desc: Samantha goes home to her family winery for the holidays after discovering that her family is in trouble. Her sister is doomed for heartbreak and her father refuses to produce new red blends after the loss of her mother, the winemaker, which will cost them the winery. She will have to believe her inner talent of winemaking while trying to woo and date the unpleasant owner of a competing winery, Parker Williams.

programme.title: Christmas Matchmakers (2024)
programme.desc: Jen and Jon are executive assistants under pressure. In order to have more free time during the holidays, they decide to build a strategy so that their respective bosses, Kate and Owen, fall madly in love with each other.

programme.title: A Date by Christmas Eve (2019)
programme.desc: When Chelsea Simms, the good-hearted brand strategist for the popular dating app The Nice List, discovers the app has granted her magical powers, she uses her newfound ability to make all of the �naughty� people in her life learn how to be good again. But when her plans go awry and Fisher, the kindly neighbor who has always carried a torch for Chelsea, is magically added to the naughty list by mistake, Chelsea must race against time to set things right before Christmas Eve.

programme.title: A Perfect Christmas Pairing (2023)
programme.desc: Winter sets in as top chef Grace Cooke, at the helm of a high-end restaurant, rakes in rave reviews due to her gastro-scientific approach to cuisine. She’s close to a Michelin star when a bad review from a top critic rocks her world. With her boss’ blessing, she takes time off to see her family at their winery B&B over Christmas. There, she connects with worldly travel writer Asher St. James, and sparks fly with family traditions as Asher helps her reconnect with her roots.

programme.title: Reporting for Christmas (2023)
programme.desc: Journalist Mary is assigned a Christmas story on the beloved holiday toy, Mistle Toad, celebrating its big anniversary. Though wary of the assignment—since the manufacturer is a major advertiser—she's promised full editorial freedom. In the toy’s hometown, she meets Blake, the founder’s son, who’s hesitant to speak out against his father’s overly commercial vision. As Mary digs for the real story, unexpected sparks begin to fly.

programme.title: A Christmas Wish in Hudson (2021)
programme.desc: Christmas is special for Lori, but she�s overworked and underappreciated. When her boss demands she work over the holidays, she quits. Unsure of her future, she sees Patrick, a widowed firefighter, on a cooking show and feels a connection. Determined, Lori travels to his hometown, Hudson, Wisconsin, but loses hope seeing other women there for the same reason. Fate brings them together, but Lori hides her true intentions, fearing she might lose him when the truth comes out.

programme.title: The Christmas Checklist (2022)
programme.desc: Emily is faced with the daunting task of fulfilling her late mother Ruby’s last wish – a twelve-task Christmas Checklist. With local freelance writer Noah covering her compelling story, his article turns from inspiring to cherished just in time for Christmas Eve, as their journey together reveals that Ruby’s final wish has been in front of them the whole time.

programme.title: A Very Charming Christmas Town (2020)
programme.desc: When lifestyle blogger Aubrey Lang visits the Danish-settled Californian village of Solvang for her big holiday piece, she at first believes the town is simply a tourist trap. But when Aubrey meets handsome community coordinator and chocolate shop owner Sawyer, to show her around town, Aubrey soon starts to fall for him and realizes the magic of Solvang's Christmas spirit shines year round.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero interrumpe el proceso de ingreso a la cárcel. La violencia domestica entre una pareja es evidente, pero ellos la niegan y dicen que en realidad era intimidad. Una mujer encarcelada con cámara escondida comparte los videos intrusivos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los guardias descubren objetos para el aseo personal escondidos en un lugar raro al revisar las pertenencias de una mujer. Un turista encarcelado amenaza con traer a Johnny Cochran como abogado para su defensa. Un conductor ebrio se despierta y encuentra una obra de arte pornográfica dibujada en su cuerpo.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso se traga un alijo de drogas y luego le vienen las ganas de comer. Un hombre de 72 años da pretextos raros para explicar porque les vende drogas a adolescentes en un centro comercial. Una mujer acusada de agredir al dueño de la propiedad finge estar enferma para salir de la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una prostituta se arresta en un día de trabajo lento. Un prisionero ebrio se mete con los guardias. Una mujer enojada le dice malas palabras a un guardia.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un mujeriego obtiene ropa interior de mujer en la cárcel. Una mujer que se detenida por un accidente automovilístico descubre incrédulamente que fumar marihuana mientras conduciendo es ilegal. Un joven acusado de manejar tomado les dice a los guardias que teme quedar embarazado tras las rejas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre ebrio declara ser parte del movimiento “Ocupar Wall Street,” protesta contra la desigualdad económica. Los oficiales luchan contra un hombre violento. Un ladrón de dulces llora cuando es detenido.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre entrenado en las artes marciales intenta zafarse de las esposas y se atora más. Una rivalidad de fútbol-estadounidense termina mal cuando un aficionado de los Steelers ataca a un uno de los Ravens.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una pareja es arrestada por obscenidad enseñando más de lo que debe. Una mujer ebria acusa que la tratan injustamente. Un hombre con un historial criminal es arrestado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un prisionero que no coopera complica la situación. Un hombre acusado de manejar tomado se queja de la comida de la prisión. Una guardia de seguridad doméstica nacional que fue arrestada por robo teme que el trabajo de sus sueños de seguridad nacional ha terminado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que fue detenida por cruzar a media calle afirma que la policía se pasó de la raya por arrestarla. Una mujer es acusada de violencia doméstica. Un traficante de drogas declara que las vende para alivianar su deuda y adicción y al póquer.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que acosa a David Copperfield es arrestada. Una prisionera ebria se queja de los guardias. Un hombre que es detenido por andar manejando afectado por medicamentos aúlla a su perro.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un delincuente reincidente intenta provocar una pelea física con los oficiales. Una vaquera ebria arma un escándalo porque le quitan las botas. Más tarde, un hombre recogido por portar un arma oculta declara que la navaja en realidad es para abrir ostras.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre ebrio con muchísimo dinero es arrestado por violar su orden de restricción. Una pareja es detenida por posesión de un vehículo robado. Una mujer arrestada se vuela con un oficial que parece gustarle.

programme.desc: En Tampa, FL, dos hombres son captados peleando por cámaras de seguridad. programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Las Vegas, NV, la unidad antivicio interroga a varias personas acusadas de delitos sexuales. En Tacoma, WA, un hombre hace amenazas suicidas y provoca una situación de alto riesgo. En Cincinnati, OH, una mujer no puede pagar la fianza y está encarcelada durante varios días.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Las Vegas, NV, hay una pelea entre prisioneros durante el desayuno. En Fort Worth, Texas, un prisionero altera su uniforme de manera provocativa. En Portland, OR, un hombre lanza amenazas violentas a los agentes.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Tampa, Florida, un hombre es colocado en una silla de inmovilización después de mostrar actos de agresión.
